feat.description: A new user-facing feature (views, models, forms, endpoints)

refactor.description: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

test.description: Adding or correcting pytest tests, fixtures, or factories

docs.description: README, CLAUDE.md, docs/, or workflow artifacts in work/

style.description: Formatting only (ruff format, djlint reformat), no logic changes

build.description: Dependencies and packaging: pyproject.toml, requirements/*.txt, Dockerfile

ci.description: GitHub Actions workflows and pre-commit hook configuration

chore.description: Repository maintenance and tooling that doesn't touch app code

scopes.<ticket-id>: Default for workflow commits: the ticket id from work/<ticket-id>/ (e.g. feat(goals-crud): ...)
scopes.config: Django project package: settings, root urls, asgi/wsgi
scopes.goals: Goal and LearningSession models, views, templates
scopes.tooling: Linters, formatters, type checking, editor config, Makefile
scopes.workflow: AI factory pipeline: .claude skills, rules, hooks

BREAKING CHANGE.description: Incompatible change (e.g. data migration, removed URL, changed env var)

Closes.description: Closes a GitHub issue, e.g. Closes #12

Refs.description: References a related issue without closing it
